query_text: A travel memory scrapbook app for the browser where each trip feels like a beautifully curated editorial spread — warm, tactile, like flipping through a vintage travel magazine someone actually loved. The main view arranges photos in a loose collage layout with slight overlaps and soft drop shadows against a cream or aged-paper background, giving everything that handcrafted, pinned-to-a-wall quality. Each trip gets its own dedicated spread with a mood-forward title in a script or serif style, a short personal note written in a way that feels intimate rather than clinical, and photos displayed at varied sizes so the whole thing breathes and feels alive. The experience should feel unhurried and cinematic on a wide desktop screen, the kind of thing you'd want to keep open just to look at.
